first_step_test: A rounded rectangular lock body in its final position gives a beginner the width, height, and centerline needed for the shackle and keyhole.

source.notes: A current-day replacement after the magnifying-glass draft failed three contact-sheet attempts; no vector art.

final_elements.name: rounded lock body
final_elements.description: One broad rounded rectangular metal case centered low on the paper.

final_elements.name: arched shackle
final_elements.description: One thick upside-down U rises behind the top of the case and meets it at two fixed points.

final_elements.name: keyhole circle
final_elements.description: One small circle centered on the front case.

final_elements.name: keyhole slot
final_elements.description: A narrow tapered opening hangs directly below the keyhole circle.

final_elements.name: case seam
final_elements.description: One short horizontal line sits near the bottom of the case.

final_elements.name: left rivet
final_elements.description: One small dot sits left of the keyhole and above the seam.

final_elements.name: right rivet
final_elements.description: One matching dot sits right of the keyhole and above the seam.

final_elements.name: ground shadow
final_elements.description: One broken oval shadow lies directly beneath the case.

frames.visible_job: Draw a broad rounded rectangle a little below the page center. Keep its upper edge level and its corners softly curved.
frames.instruction: Draw a broad rounded rectangle a little below the page center. Keep its upper edge level and its corners softly curved.

frames.visible_job: Behind the case, draw a thick upside-down U from two points along the top edge. Keep its lower ends hidden behind the case instead of crossing the front.
frames.instruction: Behind the case, draw a thick upside-down U from two points along the top edge. Keep its lower ends hidden behind the case instead of crossing the front.

frames.visible_job: Center a small dark circle on the case front, then hang a narrow tapered slot directly from its lower edge. Keep both shapes inside the case.
frames.instruction: Center a small dark circle on the case front, then hang a narrow tapered slot directly from its lower edge. Keep both shapes inside the case.

frames.visible_job: Run one short horizontal seam near the case bottom. Place one small rivet dot to either side of the keyhole above the seam.
frames.instruction: Run one short horizontal seam near the case bottom. Place one small rivet dot to either side of the keyhole above the seam.

frames.visible_job: Sketch one broken oval shadow directly below the case, leaving white gaps. Leave the shackle, keyhole, seam and two rivets where they are.
frames.instruction: Sketch one broken oval shadow directly below the case, leaving white gaps. Leave the shackle, keyhole, seam and two rivets where they are.

final_step.visible_job: Shade only the established case and shackle with warm-gray graphite, deepen the keyhole and existing shadow.
final_step.instruction: Shade the established case and shackle with warm-gray pencil, leaving a slim paper highlight along the upper right. Deepen the existing keyhole and shadow; add no new contours.
adds: warm-gray shading on established metal and shadow

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop gives a single wide rounded case, centered low with ample space above. Its straight top and curved corners are easy to copy and fix the width and attachment zone for the shackle.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I viewed the full sheet and each saved crop in order, comparing all five adjacent pairs including the finish. The case, arch attachments, centered hole, tapered slot, seam, two rivets and ground shadow keep their relationships; the last frame only deepens graphite on existing forms. No temporary guides are used.
